scheme_name: Disability Pension for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Delhi
Applicant must be a registered Building/Construction Worker of the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Applicant must have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year
Applicant must be permanently disabled due to paralysis, leprosy, tuberculosis, accident, etc.
benefits_summary: Provides a disability pension of ₹3,000 per month to eligible permanently disabled construction workers.
